name: 10918 · Chester, NY
findings: ZIP 10918 (Chester) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10918 (Chester) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10918 (Chester) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
